basics.name: Punit Mishra
basics.title: Senior ML & AI Tech Lead
basics.summary: I like taking machine learning the whole distance — from rough prototype to something a real customer can lean on — and I've done it at enterprise scale for 14+ years. As Senior ML & AI Tech Lead in SAP CX Data & AI I lead a team of thirteen while staying hands-on: I architect the systems and also write, deploy, and own them end to end, from agent runtimes and LLM inference pipelines to GPU serving on custom bare-metal H100 clusters. Recently I brought SAP's own LLM (Nova) into our natural-language-to-SQL stack — raising SQL accuracy while cutting dependence on external frontier models — and architected a hardened internal-auth contract that closes a cross-tenant data-leak class. I also architect APEX, our Domain Data Access Agents platform. I care about the "so what": measurable accuracy, automated onboarding over manual tenant setup, latency cut on our flagship retail deployment, security you can actually verify. Deep in Python and Rust, with multi-model serving, distributed inference, vector search, and secure, ethical AI.

experience.position: Senior ML & AI Tech Lead — CX Data & AI
experience.summary: I lead a team of thirteen and stay hands-on — architecting and personally building the agent platform, LLM serving, and multi-tenant infrastructure beneath SAP CX's LLM products.
highlights: I brought SAP's own LLM, Nova, into our natural-language-to-SQL stack (S/4HANA + Ariba) as a first-class alternative to Claude — self-hosted serving, a retriever-reranker, and seven benchmark lanes — lifting NL-to-SQL decision-match accuracy 59.2% → 64.8% (reranking 50% → 53%) while cutting dependence on external frontier models; NL-to-SQL ships in SAP's 2026 public and private cloud releases

I architected the hardened internal-auth contract (ADR 0021) — a constant-time shared-secret check before any tenant header is trusted, canonical tenant resolution, and IAS alongside XSUAA — shipped backward-compatibly across four services to close a real cross-tenant data-leak class

I architect APEX, our Domain Data Access Agents platform, and turned it from manual, XSUAA-only tenancy into direct app tenancy auto-provisioned via BTP UCL formations, enabling self-service customer onboarding — and serve as forward-deployed engineer bringing up our first production enterprise customer, a Fortune 500 retailer

I rewrote the legacy Shopping Assistant's vision (Vision-DNA, object detection, visual search) into first-class Domain Data Access Agent services behind a unified Agent Gateway and an MCP Hub, turning dead-end legacy code into reusable, discoverable services
I lead a team of thirteen and set technical direction through the ADRs I author, our SDLC and engineering standards, and AI ethics & compliance as an SAP Security Expert

I built the APEX Control Panel, a Next.js provisioning UI (IAS OIDC PKCE + server-side BFF) covering onboarding, formations, agent and data-ingestion config, playground, sessions, and handoff, and folded the AutoSQL eval dashboard into a HANA-backed Nova dashboard on Gardener — self-service operational visibility and a reusable FDE UI scaffold

I run multi-model serving — self-hosted Nova alongside Claude, Qwen, and Granite-class models — on custom bare-metal H100 clusters, and introduced Ray plus automated eval harnesses so we choose models on measurable accuracy, not intuition

I cut "ask a product" answer latency on a Fortune 500 retailer's in-store concierge from ~25s to ~10s and added grounded follow-ups that stop product drift — real customer-facing speed and quality wins on our flagship deployment

I write the performance-critical hot paths of APEX, our domain-agnostic Domain Data Access Agents platform, in Rust so one agent runtime is fast and cheap enough to reuse across products instead of rebuilding per use case

experience.position: Senior Software Engineer — Thunderbridge AI / SAP Sales Cloud
experience.summary: Joined via CallidusCloud, acquired by SAP for $2.4B. Built the Thunderbridge AI ML platform and the CI/CD backbone; earlier, senior automation engineering.
highlights: Designed and built the Thunderbridge AI backend in Python on Dataiku, with multi-tenancy running every customer workload for SAP Sales Cloud optimization
Ported the full Dataiku ML stack to GKE on-prem (Google Anthos) with Istio; built the CI/CD backbone (Jenkins on Kubernetes, Kaniko, Artifactory) plus automated merges (Bulldozer / Policy-Bot)
Engineered multi-partition data resiliency for ML across Oracle, Vertica, SAP HANA, and HDFS (Spark); shipped inference services for CPQ on Dataiku's API node

Integrated SAP security scans (Coverity, Black Duck, Fortify) into Jenkins per commit; earlier, as Senior Automation Engineer, built TDD/Scala ETL validation and Selenium/Java + Node.js UI test frameworks over a self-maintaining Selenium Grid

experience.summary: Automation and test engineering for a major US bank.
highlights: Built a reporting and data-validation automation framework for a major US bank
Automated VM creation/configuration via a WCF SOAP service (IIS); parallelized and scheduled test execution across cloud machines with varied OS/browser configs
Developed reusable Selenium / Java test APIs (JUnit, TestNG) adopted across the firm
Built an online teaching-evaluation system for the Law School on a PHP / Oracle 10g backend, integrated with CalNet (Berkeley authentication) for end-of-course student evaluations
Built user-to-user interaction features on the Django backend and an internal analytics tool visualizing user data (logins, time on site) used by the sales team
Automated testing with Selenium IDE and tracked defects; worked with the founding team on wireframes and AWS server configuration

projects.name: CoViber
projects.description: Local-first memory for LLMs over the Model Context Protocol. Maintains a continuously-updated work graph, triage queue, and local semantic memory — no cloud egress.

projects.name: Vaultic
projects.description: Local-first, encrypted password manager in Rust with FIDO2/YubiKey support. One on-disk format shared by CLI, TUI, daemon, GUI, and MCP server. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.

projects.name: Shield AI
projects.description: AI-powered DNS filtering with real-time ML threat scoring. Rust core + TypeScript dashboard — ~15MB resident, <1ms lookups at 100K+ QPS, with a live demo and a macOS/iOS DNS profile.

projects.name: Railroad Arcade
projects.description: Full-stack IoT app to control a real HO-scale model railroad remotely — Next.js frontend on Vercel with a Rust backend on a Raspberry Pi driving the physical hardware. Free demo mode or live control.

projects.name: RailCommand Firmware
projects.description: Multi-node ESP32-C3 firmware for the RailCommand model-railroad control system.

projects.name: Pi Race
projects.description: Zero-dependency Rust CLI that benchmarks four classic π algorithms (Ramanujan, Euler/Basel, Wallis, Leibniz) head-to-head on accuracy and speed. CI cross-compiles for Linux/macOS/Windows and posts weekly timing tables.
